hints.hideAfter: 0 keeps messages until new ones push them out.
hints.ignoredUsers: Bots and users whose messages are hidden. Press Enter after each name.
hints.text: Leave empty for the default. Tokens: {'{name}'} {'{count}'} {'{months}'} {'{tier}'}. Plural: {'{count|sub|subs}'}.
hints.textResub: Used when months is greater than 1. Leave empty for the default.
hints.min: Smaller amounts don't trigger an alert.
hints.minMessages: Same emote in this many different messages.
hints.countdownTo: Local time. Leave empty to hide the countdown.
hints.title: Leave empty for the default text for the selected mode.
hints.sceneBackground: 3D looks great but uses the GPU. Pick a lighter background if your game stutters.
hints.perMessage: For rain, rise and fly. Explosions and fountains use “Emotes per explosion”.
hints.commandPrefix: Votes look like prefix + number, e.g. !1. Leave empty to accept plain numbers.
hints.allowChange: Otherwise only the first vote counts.
hints.autoClose: Counted from Start. 0 = until you press Stop.
hints.command: Also works: command+ command- command set 10 command reset
hints.cooldown: Ignores the command when used again too quickly.
hints.keyword: Viewers type exactly this in chat to join.
hints.firstMode: Twitch marks real first messages. Kick has no such flag, so it always uses the first message in this session.
hints.spotlightCommand: e.g. !msg Hello everyone. Leave empty to turn it off.
hints.startMinutes: Used on Reset. Press Start in Actions to begin the countdown.
hints.tierMultiplier: Tier 2 adds twice as much, Tier 3 three times.
hints.startValue: Progress you already had before this stream.
hints.lines: Press Enter after each text. Empty = default welcome text.
hints.clockMode: Uptime is read from Twitch or Kick every minute.
hints.triggers: Pick what starts the effect. Chat uses the emotes from the message.
hints.scaleWithAmount: More gifted subs, bits or raiders = more emotes (up to 10×).
hints.alertEmotes: Emote names from your channel, e.g. KEKW. Empty = random emotes from your 7TV/BTTV/FFZ set.
hints.spread: How far emotes fly from the center of an explosion.
hints.rewards: Exact reward titles. Press Enter after each one.
hints.goalSource: “Channel total” uses real follower and sub counts from Twitch (login required) and Kick followers. Bits and gifts always count this stream.
hints.endHold: How long the final level stays after the train ends.
hints.combine: Adds Twitch and Kick viewers into one number.
hints.alertImage: Shown above the text in the “Image on top” layout (Style tab).
hints.alertLayout: “Image on top” shows the image of each alert type with the text below it.
